name: Tobit
description: Son of Tobiel, of the tribe of Nephthali, led captive to Nineve under Enemessar; walked in the ways of truth and justice, gave alms and buried the dead at the risk of his life, lost his sight from sparrow dung and was healed by Raphael; husband of Anna and father of Tobias

points: Tobit of the tribe of Naphtali was carried captive by Shalmaneser to Nineveh; he walked in truth and gave alms to his brethren who came with him into the land of the Assyrians.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: Tobit walked all the days of his life in the way of truth and justice and did many almsdeeds to his brethren. Remember he was of the northern kingdom, the tribe of Nephthali, in the Assyrian captivity. All the tribe of Nephthali fell from the house of Jerusalem and sacrificed unto the heifer Baal, but Tobit alone went often to Jerusalem at the feasts, having the firstfruits and tenths of increase.

At Pentecost Tobit had a good dinner and sent his son for any poor man of our brethren mindful of the Lord: a man of charity who kept the feast and had abundance because he prepared, the kind of brother you want around in a famine.

Sent to fetch a poor brother mindful of the Lord, Tobias came back saying one of our nation is strangled in the marketplace; Tobit left his meat, hid the body until sundown and buried it, remembering Amos, your feasts shall be turned into mourning.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

points: The prayers of them both were heard, and Raphael was sent to heal Tobit's eyes and to give Sarah to Tobias, because she belonged to Tobias by right of inheritance.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah
